purpose: Chapter 1 broad ore field scanned rock, fractured face and gravel provenance; no collision or material authority

rock_gravel_patch.authors: Rob Tuytel, photography and processing; Rico Cilliers, cleanup
rock_gravel_patch.preparation: meshoptimizer gltfpack 1.3 Linux SHA-256 595441045457bf3d069ec14fa807b1034d324db003bd66ac6377977cc11e7da3: gltfpack -i coast_land_rocks_03_2k.gltf -o coast-land-03-compact.glb -si 0.04 -se 0.02 -sp -noq -tw -tq 9 -tl color 1024 -tl normal,attrib 512 -v -r coast-land-03-compact-report.json. The source has 1,096,655 triangles; the glTF result has 43,866 triangles, 1k WebP color and 512-pixel normal and ARM images. The satellite gravel fragments use the smaller maps so the fractured-face addition remains within the installed 128 MiB Godot import allowance.

rock_face.author: Dario Barresi
rock_face.preparation: meshoptimizer gltfpack 1.3 Linux SHA-256 595441045457bf3d069ec14fa807b1034d324db003bd66ac6377977cc11e7da3: gltfpack -i rock_face_01_1k.gltf -o rock-face-01.glb -si 0.85 -se 0.01 -sp -noq -tw -tq 9 -v -r rock-face-01-report.json. The source mesh has 20,174 triangles and the prepared glTF has 17,146 triangles with 1k WebP maps. The face is laid nearly flat and embedded in the bank as a low fractured exposure.

field_gravel.authors: Dimitrios Savva, photography; Dario Barresi, processing

limits: The photographed rocks, gravel and copper shader are presentation only. Source glTF files remain in the task private family; the existing mineral-soil texture and original physical source retain their own provenance. Passive renders cannot establish player collision, collector clearance, depletion in ordinary play, or performance.
